array.string: u="${USER:-$(id -un)}" target="/tmp/com.waxdred.skyland-$u.sock" link="/tmp/bobko.aerospace-$u.sock" i=0 while [ $i -lt 120 ]; do if /usr/bin/pgrep -x AeroSpace >/dev/null; then echo "$(date) AeroSpace running, link untouched"; exit 0; fi if [ -S "$target" ]; then /bin/ln -sfn "$target" "$link" && echo "$(date) USER=$USER HOME=$HOME linked $link -> $target" exit 0 fi i=$((i+1)); /bin/sleep 1 done echo "$(date) Skyland socket not found, gave up" exit 1
